role_title: Lead Product Manager (Growth Product Lead, Benefits Marketplace & PEO)

must_have.requirement: 8+ years of product management experience, including meaningful ownership of growth in B2B products.
must_have.evidence_summary: 10+ years of overall product, growth, and strategy experience, including 6+ years in formal PM/SPM titles (Byju's 2020–2023, Lowe's 2024–Present), 4 years in earlier product prototyping/team lead roles at Byju's (2015–2020), and B2B client growth/GTM consulting as Founder of Hype (2023–2024). However, primary high-scale product-led growth ownership was in B2C/EdTech (Byju's) and B2B consulting rather than 8+ years strictly in B2B SaaS growth PM.
must_have.positioning_bridge: Combine 10-year product/growth trajectory across Byju's (2.5L+ SQLs, 35% conversion lift), Hype B2B client growth/GTM engagements, and Lowe's enterprise B2B platforms.

must_have.requirement: Track record of delivering measurable business outcomes (revenue, qualified demand, funnel conversion, retention, adoption) through a combination of product and go-to-market levers.
must_have.evidence_summary: Generated 2.5L+ sales-qualified leads and improved lead conversion by 35% for Byju's Xcel Masterclasses; drove 50% engagement and 30% traffic growth for Upraised, 30% email open rate and 20% CTR for Gradiant, 35% organic traffic growth at HealthQ Rehab, and ~$10M revenue protection + $2M cost savings at Lowe's India.
must_have.positioning_bridge: Directly showcase quantified full-funnel outcomes across qualified demand (2.5L+ SQLs), conversion (+35%), and revenue protection (~$10M).

must_have.requirement: Own growth strategy, product-led growth plan, and top-of-funnel experiments across organic, in-product, partner, and sales-led channels.
must_have.evidence_summary: Led Product-Led Growth, GTM strategy, funnel optimization, SEO/organic growth (+35%), lifecycle email marketing, and cross-product engagement prototypes across Byju's, Hype, and HealthQ Rehab.
must_have.positioning_bridge: Directly align PLG, GTM, and multi-channel top-of-funnel experimentation experience.

must_have.requirement: Excellent analytical skills: define a funnel, build a business case, segment customers, evaluate experiments, and turn ambiguous data into clear decisions.
must_have.evidence_summary: Built KPI frameworks, business cases, ROI evaluations, and funnel conversion experiments across Lowe's India, Byju's, and Hype.
must_have.positioning_bridge: Emphasize analytical rigor across funnel conversion metrics and executive ROI prioritization.

must_have.requirement: Strong technical fluency and systems thinking: work effectively with engineers on data models, integrations, AI-powered workflows, operational tooling, and platform capabilities.
must_have.evidence_summary: B.Tech. in CSE; built AI-driven procurement and catalog workflows, automated recovery systems, enterprise asset lifecycle platforms at Lowe's India, and internal tracking tooling (Elevate) at Byju's.
must_have.positioning_bridge: Highlight rare combination of growth/GTM leadership and technical enterprise platform/AI workflow execution.

preferred.requirement: Experience in benefits, insurance, PEO, payroll, marketplaces, partner ecosystems, or B2B2C products.
preferred.evidence_summary: No US benefits, health insurance, PEO, broker marketplace, or payroll domain experience is documented in canonical_master_profile.md.
preferred.positioning_bridge: Acknowledge PEO/benefits domain gap; bridge from multi-product ecosystem cross-sell (12 cross-product prototypes across Aakash-Byju's, Tynker, WhiteHat Jr.) and enterprise procurement/catalog systems at Lowe's.

preferred.requirement: Founder or hypergrowth startup experience is a strong plus.
preferred.evidence_summary: Founder of Hype Marketing & Product Services (Oct 2023–Nov 2024) and spent 8 years scaling products during Byju's hypergrowth phase (2015–2023).
preferred.positioning_bridge: Strong direct match on both Founder experience and hypergrowth scaling.

implicit.requirement: Expand TAM by shaping positioning, packaging, product entry points, and cross-functional investments across Sales, Marketing, Design, Engineering, and Operations.
implicit.evidence_summary: Combined product positioning, content strategy, GTM planning, and funnel entry points to launch new offerings at Hype (Upraised, Programming Hub) and scale Byju's Xcel Masterclasses (2.5L+ SQLs).
implicit.positioning_bridge: Directly showcase end-to-end ownership at the intersection of Product, Growth, and GTM.

domain.requirement: B2B HR Tech / Benefits Marketplace / PEO & Broker Distribution Channels.
domain.evidence_summary: No prior HR Tech, PEO, or employee benefits marketplace experience in canonical_master_profile.md.
domain.positioning_bridge: Position horizontal growth, funnel conversion, GTM packaging, and catalog platform skills as transferable to the Benefits Marketplace & PEO vertical.
